$comment: AWS Signature Version 4 conformance vectors for BYOC's S3-compatible adapter. The first vector's signature was independently verified against a clean-room implementation written directly from the AWS specification, so it is an external check rather than a self-generated snapshot. Every SDK must reproduce these byte-for-byte or it cannot talk to S3/R2/MinIO.

rules.body_hash: sha256 of the request body; for an empty body use the sha256 of the empty string (NOT 'UNSIGNED-PAYLOAD'). Presigned URLs are the exception and use UNSIGNED-PAYLOAD.
rules.header_normalization: lowercase the key, strip surrounding whitespace from the value, collapse internal whitespace runs to a single space, then sort by key
rules.canonical_query: RFC 3986 encode key and value (slashes encoded), sort by encoded key then encoded value, join with &

canonical_query.note: '+' in a query value decodes to a space and must re-encode as %20, never '+'

vectors.name: GET with x-amz-storage-class, empty body
vectors.note: independently verified against a clean-room SigV4 implementation

vectors.name: PUT with mixed-case Content-Type and an encoded key
vectors.note: header casing must not change the signature

vectors.name: GET ListObjectsV2 with multiple query params

presigned.name: presigned GET, 3600s
presigned.note: presigned URLs sign with UNSIGNED-PAYLOAD and host-only signed headers
